clues: This city stands where a wide river runs into the Baltic Sea. The land round it is flat and sandy, a plain that runs to the shore.
The sea near this city brings thick fog and much rain in fall. Snow can lie on the ground for eighty days in a row.
This city was founded in 1201, long ago, and it joined a league of sea trading towns. Its past as a port goes back to that same start.
Its old centre is a world treasure site, famed for its Art Nouveau style. Rows of fine wooden houses from the old days stand there too.
One last sure sign: this city is the capital of Latvia. It is the top city of the land, first in rank and in size.
